captions: Bartek opens the Wrenfield's page on his phone and the gift box hangs off the edge.
Its orange border runs past the right edge, and the whole page slides sideways.
You fix how the gift box and the email field are sized, and keep how they look.
On the phone the gift box sits inside the page, and the footer's field fits too.
Same boxes, same padding and borders, and nothing hangs off the edge any more.
